title: Acer’s adorable 3-in-1 ‘coffee cup’ iPhone charger is 40% off today
content:
Macworld

Acer 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station

View Deal

If you charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods on your nightstand or desk all week, the best thing you can do is get a multi-device charging station. This 3-in-1 Acer model is just what you need to handle your gear, and today it’s down to $60, a savings of 40 percent off its usual price and the best we’ve ever seen.

The first thing that stands out about this dock is its design. Shaped like a coffee cup, it’s has a unique shape that’s as functional as it is cute. The magnetic phone charging pad folds away, and the watch pad pops back in, so if you want to take this with you on a trip, it’s easy to pop into a bag. Also quite nice if you place this on your nightstand, the base cycles through warm white, RGB color effects, and a soft ice-blue glow if you want a nightlght.

Whether you use this dock on your nightstand or place it on your desk, you’ll get to charge three of your devices at once. And you’ll do that quickly too, because the wireless charging pad for your phone delivers 25W of speed, while the earbuds get 5W and the Apple Watch 2.5W. It comes with a 45W power adapter and USB-C cable included, which is a nice touch.

So go get organized and snatch this Acer triple charger for $60 while this 40 percent discount is still live.
